# Engineering New-Hire Onboarding Guide

Week 1 checklist for new engineers:

1. IT provisions your laptop and GitHub/GitLab access by your start date — contact
   it-helpdesk@alderbrooksystems.example if not received 24 hours prior.
2. Complete the "Engineering 101" course in the LMS covering our monorepo structure, CI/CD
   pipeline (Buildkite), and code review standards.
3. Get added to the #eng-onboarding channel and your team's Slack channel by your manager.
4. Request VPN and production read-only access via the Access Request form — production write
   access requires 30 days tenure plus manager approval.
5. Pair with your onboarding buddy (assigned by your manager) for your first two weeks.
